note: The experiment registry (P53): the battery (tasks/BATTERY.md) as data. Each family carries its effect metric, declared scale, machine-checkable judge checks (declared BEFORE execution, M5.13), grounding practice, and status. Any agent session can pick the next pending family via 'harness battery --next', execute both conditions per the spec, and harvest scaled receipts - the self-experimentation loop. Done families keep their results and the round that ran them. A family is done only when BOTH conditions have receipts recorded in the tool home traces. P67 metabolism: the parsing and reading-extraction families ran in P62 but were never registered here (the receipts existed, the registry row did not - the M5.13 pre-declaration was partial: checks are visible in the receipts' checks_total/defects but were not filed in this registry before the run); registered retroactively with that gap acknowledged. P70: a 10th family, agent-eval-reliability, is registered PENDING with judge_checks pre-declared but NO results - the benchmark-grounded pass^k reliability trial (τ-bench/ThinkingBox bar, references §AE R282-R290); its trial_project is a planned run, so reconcile skips pending families (a plan asserts no receipts yet).

spec.task: Pick one recurring factory task (e.g. lit-review citation resolution). Run it n>=k times under A-bare and n>=k times under B-harness, grading the terminal state each time (does the deliverable actually resolve its citations, not what the model claims).
spec.conditions: A bare: raw model, no harness gate, one-shot vs repeated. B harness: full factory loop (router -> gates -> provenance). The measured axis is reliability (pass^k), not the single best score.
spec.judge: machine: per-receipt state check feeds pass^k = mean over tasks with n>=k of C(c,k)/C(n,k) (see harness passk). Insufficient n reads as 'not measurable' (M5.11/M5.12) - results are observed, never fabricated; judge_checks are pre-declared here before any run (M5.13).

families.notes: P76 genuine-variance run supersedes the P67 determinism run (updates/dogfood/p67-reliability: 3 identical heredoc inputs, all exit 0 - variance was zero by construction). P76: same task (chunk_equal per pre-declared SPEC.md) x 3 independent sampled attempts x both conditions, judge = 10 pre-declared hidden tests on terminal state (evaluator independent, M3.18). pass^3 = 1.0 BOTH arms, pass@1 = 1.0 both - the instance does NOT discriminate the conditions (observed, M5.11); variance is real (6 distinct solution hashes, three implementation paths per arm). Scope: same-session same-model sampling variance; cross-session/cross-model variance and a discriminative task instance remain open (next-round worklist).
